title: Sage weather record
description: A weather record (WeatherRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another weather record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

fogTint.description: With a sky: multiplies the sky's fog colour (a storm's grey is a dark tint) Category: Sky. (Vector3, default [1,1,1])

skyTint.description: With a sky: multiplies the sky's horizon and zenith colours. Category: Sky. (Vector3, default [1,1,1])

cloudCover.description: With a sky that names a cloud picture: how much of the sky is cloud, 0 clear to 1 overcast; blended as the weather changes (issue 4n-16) Range: 0 to 1. Category: Sky. (float, default 0.3)

fogStartScale.description: With a sky: multiplies where fog begins (below 1 pulls it in) At least 0. Category: Sky. (float, default 1)

fogEndScale.description: With a sky: multiplies where fog is complete. At least 0. Category: Sky. (float, default 1)

shelteredVolume.description: Under a roof or inside: the share of the sound's volume left (1 = not muffled) Range: 0 to 1. Category: Cover. (float, default 0.25)

lightningRate.description: Average lightning strikes a minute; 0 is none. Unit: /min. At least 0. Category: Lightning. (float, default 0)

lightningFlash.description: How bright the flash is at its peak: added to the sky and the ambient light. Range: 0 to 2. Category: Lightning. (float, default 0.8)

thunder.description: The sound a strike is heard as, once the thunder has travelled. Names a sound record. Category: Lightning. (RecordRef<SoundRecord>)

thunderVolume.description: The thunder's volume (a strike heard from under a roof is muffled by ShelteredVolume too) Range: 0 to 1. Category: Lightning. (float, default 1)
